root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SysDataTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.SysDataTbl', N'ShowAreaOnDeliverySheet') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.SysDataTbl ADD ShowAreaOnDeliverySheet BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_SysDataTbl_ShowAreaOnDeliverySheet DEFAULT (1); END
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.AreasTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.AreasTbl', N'ShortCode') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.AreasTbl ADD ShortCode NVARCHAR(5) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.AreaPrepDaysTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.AreasTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AreaPrepDaysTbl WHERE DeliveryOrder IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AreaPrepDaysTbl GROUP BY AreaID HAVING MIN(DeliveryOrder) <> MAX(DeliveryOrder)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT AreaID, MIN(DeliveryOrder) AS AreaOrder FROM dbo.AreaPrepDaysTbl GROUP BY AreaID) x GROUP BY x.AreaOrder HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)) BEGIN ;WITH AreaRank AS ( SELECT p.AreaID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ISNULL(MIN(p.DeliveryOrder), 32767), MIN(ISNULL(a.AreaName, N'')), p.AreaID) AS RankNo FROM dbo.AreaPrepDaysTbl p LEFT JOIN dbo.AreasTbl a ON a.AreaID = p.AreaID GROUP BY p.AreaID ) UPDATE p SET DeliveryOrder = r.RankNo * 10 FROM dbo.AreaPrepDaysTbl p JOIN AreaRank r ON r.AreaID = p.AreaID; END
